name: How can I fix a slow drain myself?

mainEntity.name: How can I fix a slow drain myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: For an isolated slow drain, you might try a plunger, pouring boiling water (avoid on PVC pipes), or using a natural drain cleaner like baking soda and vinegar. However, if multiple drains are slow throughout your house, these DIY methods are unlikely to resolve the underlying issue, which often lies in the main sewer line. Attempting to clear a main line blockage without proper tools can sometimes worsen the problem or damage your plumbing system. It's best to call a professional for whole-house slow drains.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can try plungers or natural cleaners for isolated slow drains. For whole-house issues, DIY methods are often ineffective and professional help is recommended to avoid further damage.
